# googleworkspace_license_assignments (Data Source)

License Assignments data source in the Terraform Googleworkspace provider. It lists the users that have a license for a product, or for one SKU of a product.

This data source uses these OAuth scopes. The provider's default scopes do not include `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/apps.licensing`, and `oauth_scopes` replaces the default list, so set `oauth_scopes` to all the scopes that your configuration needs:

- `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/apps.licensing` (always).
- `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/admin.directory.customer.readonly` or `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/admin.directory.customer` (only if `customer_id` is `my_customer`).

The list requests send the provider's `customer_id` as the `customerId` parameter. The API reference documents this parameter as the customer's unique ID, such as `C00000000`, and the API guide shows the customer's primary domain name. Neither documents the `my_customer` alias. If `customer_id` is `my_customer`, the provider gets the unique customer ID once from the Directory API and sends that ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# All license assignments of a product
data "googleworkspace_license_assignments" "workspace" {
  product_id = "Google-Apps"
}

# The license assignments of one SKU of a product
data "googleworkspace_license_assignments" "business-starter" {
  product_id = "Google-Apps"
  sku_id     = "1010020027"
}

output "business_starter_users" {
  value = data.googleworkspace_license_assignments.business-starter.license_assignments[*].user_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `product_id` (String) The product's unique identifier, for example `Google-Apps`. See [Products and SKUs](https://developers.google.com/workspace/admin/licensing/v1/how-tos/products).

### Optional

- `sku_id` (String) The product SKU's unique identifier. If set, only the license assignments of this SKU are listed. If not set, the license assignments of all SKUs of the product are listed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `license_assignments` (List of Object) A list of license assignments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--license_assignments))

<a id="nestedatt--license_assignments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `license_assignments`

Read-Only:

- `product_id` (String)
- `sku_id` (String)
- `sku_name` (String)
- `user_id` (String)
